create_qre_solver: create a QRE solver instance with configurable temperature, learning rate, and projection method
compute_qre_gradients: compute exploitability gradients for a symmetric game using full or stochastic gradient estimation
run_mirror_descent_step: run entropic mirror descent update step on the QRE distribution estimate
run_euclidean_descent_step: run projected gradient descent update step with euclidean simplex projection
compute_qre_exploitability: compute Shannon entropy regularized exploitability of the current QRE distribution
